notes: Sheet is drawn in two separate parts with different page frames: the upper part covers West 6th to Opera Place (y 560-1790) and the lower part covers Opera Place to West 5th (y 3130-4170). Opera Place appears in both parts, so Elm/Opera Place and Race/Opera Place are each recorded twice ('part' field); the two copies must not be used in one frame. Opera Place is printed 'OPERA PL. (LONGWORTH)' / 'OPERA PL. (SQ.)'; it continues west of Elm as the 60' Longworth Street and east of Race at the same 40' width. Elm/West 6th is the middle of the four block corners (y=823): West 6th is the 120' market space west of Elm (centreline y=776) and 66' east of Elm (centreline y=871). 'The Normandy' printed along Race between Thorpe Alley and Opera Place is a building, not a street. The west-of-Elm alley stubs (Thorpe y=1269, Hatters y=3640) are outlines of the sheet 30 block and are schematic: sheet 31 puts Thorpe east of Elm 48 px south of the west stub and Hatters east of Elm 85 px north of it, while sheet 30's detailed drawing puts the east-of-Elm pieces 31 px north (Thorpe) and level within 8 px (Hatters). Thorpe Alley and Hatters Alley continue straight across Race (within 6 px).
